affected_party: QIF users and operators evaluating interrupted or stopped agent workflows
actual_problem: A retry or recovery can be declared finished before delayed external effects become observable, leaving effect state inconsistent or unknown
why_it_matters: Premature closure can hide duplicate notifications, late writes, unfinished rollback, or effects that continue after stop and can cause operational loss
why_now: Durable agent runtimes increasingly resume from checkpoints while current QIF v0.6.50 records point-in-time effect state but not observation windows or later reconciliation
